pages.text: Controls the weather and the time of day. It needs power and holds 8 million OP.$(br2)$(l)Weather$():$(li)Stop rain or start rain: 256,000 OP$(li)Start a thunderstorm: 384,000 OP

$(l)Time$(): skip to sunrise, midday, sunset, moonrise, midnight or moonset, or skip a full day. Time is wound forward quickly, not jumped, at 320 OP per tick of time, so a full day costs about 7.7 million OP. The stop button ends it early.

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: The redstone tab picks which action a redstone signal starts. In $(l)Skip 24$() mode, turning the signal off stops the time skip early.$(br2)It only changes the clock; machines and crops do not get extra ticks.$(br2)The recipe uses a $(item)Dragon Egg$() and a Wyvern Core.
